og.title: Download the desktop app
og.summary: Record video call audio on Mac and Windows
og.label: Desktop app

heading: Install the HeyMoa app
lead: Capture what's said in the meeting room, plus what you hear in video calls, lectures, and YouTube videos.

mac.need: Apple silicon Mac with macOS 14.2 or later
steps: Open the DMG file you downloaded.
Drag HeyMoa into your Applications folder, then open it.
If a “Windows protected your PC” window appears, click “More info.”
Click “Run anyway” and finish the installation.

homebrew.intro: If you use Homebrew, you can install it with this command.
homebrew.label: Homebrew install command

permissions: After installing, allow microphone access. On a Mac, the app asks for permission to record your computer's audio the first time you record.
guide: Permission settings and updates are covered in <link>Using the desktop app</link>.
